articles.highlight: 由于我们的意识在事物的形成中扮演一定角色，注意力的运用既能创造也能毁灭，但永远不会让对象保持不变。

articles.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Official docs + Expert analysis
articles.summary: 这篇文章通过实测拆解了 ChatGPT Work：它面向付费用户，提供可联网的代码执行环境、无头 Chrome 浏览器、跨会话持久文件系统、ChatGPT Sites、子代理和定时任务等功能。作者还利用让 Work 自述的方式，发现它注册了 223 个工具和 44 个技能，并指出官方用“用途”而非“机制”来解释产品、隐藏系统提示词，是它令人困惑的根源。对想搞清这类通用代理实际能力与边界的读者很有价值。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心启示：判断一个代理产品时，重点看它实际暴露的工具、权限与数据隔离机制；ChatGPT Work 同时具备私密数据、不受信内容和能把信息外传的能力，提示注入风险需要被认真对待。
articles.highlight: ChatGPT Work 是一个极其令人困惑但又非常强大的产品，而且实际上包含了云端与本地桌面两个不同产品。
articles.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far.

zh.title: 理解 ChatGPT Work：一个强大但令人困惑的 AI 代理产品
zh.highlight: ChatGPT Work 是一个极其令人困惑但又非常强大的产品，而且实际上包含了云端与本地桌面两个不同产品。
zh.summary: 这篇文章通过实测拆解了 ChatGPT Work：它面向付费用户，提供可联网的代码执行环境、无头 Chrome 浏览器、跨会话持久文件系统、ChatGPT Sites、子代理和定时任务等功能。作者还利用让 Work 自述的方式，发现它注册了 223 个工具和 44 个技能，并指出官方用“用途”而非“机制”来解释产品、隐藏系统提示词，是它令人困惑的根源。对想搞清这类通用代理实际能力与边界的读者很有价值。
zh.failureAnalysis: 核心启示：判断一个代理产品时，重点看它实际暴露的工具、权限与数据隔离机制；ChatGPT Work 同时具备私密数据、不受信内容和能把信息外传的能力，提示注入风险需要被认真对待。

en.highlight: ChatGPT Work is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product, and it actually comes in two flavors: cloud-based and local desktop.
en.summary: This article dissects ChatGPT Work through hands-on experimentation: it offers paid users an internet-connected code execution environment, a headless Chrome browser, a persistent filesystem across sessions, ChatGPT Sites, sub-agents, and scheduled tasks. The author also got Work to describe itself and discovered 223 registered tools and 44 skills, noting that OpenAI explains Work in terms of what it is for rather than what it actually does, and hides its system prompts, which is the root of the confusion. It is valuable for readers who want to understand the real capabilities and boundaries of this kind of general agent.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: when evaluating an agent product, focus on the tools, permissions, and data isolation mechanisms it actually exposes. Since ChatGPT Work combines private data, untrusted content, and a channel to exfiltrate information, prompt injection risk deserves serious attention.
en.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work: a powerful but confusing AI agent product

articles.summary: 该项目在 Hacker News 上展示，宣称 Sprocket 是硬件和软件开发的最佳 AI 代理，获得 124 分和 15 条评论。它尝试将 AI 代理应用于跨硬件与软件的全栈开发场景，因此值得关注其可行性与真实效果。
articles.failureAnalysis: “最佳”属于强营销表述，但硬件开发涉及物理约束和专有工具链，AI 代理的自动化能力有限。HN 热榜可能来自演示效果而非实际落地，同时用户需上传专有代码和设计数据，安全和信任问题也会阻碍采用。
articles.highlight: 展示 HN：Sprocket——硬件与软件开发的最佳 AI 代理。

en.highlight: Show HN: Sprocket – The Best AI Agent for Hardware and Software Development.
en.summary: This project is showcased on Hacker News, claiming Sprocket is the best AI agent for hardware and software development, with 124 points and 15 comments. It proposes applying AI agents to full-stack development across hardware and software, which is worth reading for its feasibility and actual results.
en.failureAnalysis: The 'best' claim is strong marketing, but hardware development involves physical constraints and proprietary toolchains, limiting AI automation. Winning HN's front page may reflect demo appeal rather than real adoption, and concerns about uploading proprietary code and design data may hinder trust.
